          not every time as would happen with the --prepare option.
      --reference <CMD>
          The reference command for the relative comparison of results. If this
          is unset, results are compared with the fastest command as reference.
      --reference-name <CMD>
          Give a meaningful name to the reference command.
  -p, --prepare <CMD>
          Execute CMD before each timing run. This is useful for clearing disk
          caches, for example.
          The --prepare option can be specified once for all commands or
          multiple times, once for each command. In the latter case, each
          preparation command will be run prior to the corresponding benchmark
          command.
  -C, --conclude <CMD>
          Execute CMD after each timing run. This is useful for killing
          long-running processes started (e.g. a web server started in
          --prepare), for example.
          The --conclude option can be specified once for all commands or
          multiple times, once for each command. In the latter case, each
          conclude command will be run after the corresponding benchmark
          command.
  -c, --cleanup <CMD>
          Execute CMD after the completion of all benchmarking runs for each
          individual command to be benchmarked. This is useful if the commands
          to be benchmarked produce artifacts that need to be cleaned up.
  -P, --parameter-scan <VAR> <MIN> <MAX>
          Perform benchmark runs for each value in the range MIN..MAX. Replaces
          the string '{VAR}' in each command by the current parameter value.
          
            Example:  hyperfine -P threads 1 8 'make -j {threads}'
          
          This performs benchmarks for 'make -j 1', 'make -j 2', …, 'make -j 8'.
          
          To have the value increase following different patterns, use shell
          arithmetics.
          
            Example: hyperfine -P size 0 3 'sleep $((2**{size}))'
          
          This performs benchmarks with power of 2 increases: 'sleep 1', 'sleep
          2', 'sleep 4', …
          The exact syntax may vary depending on your shell and OS.
  -D, --parameter-step-size <DELTA>
          This argument requires --parameter-scan to be specified as well.
          Traverse the range MIN..MAX in steps of DELTA.
          
            Example:  hyperfine -P delay 0.3 0.7 -D 0.2 'sleep {delay}'
          
          This performs benchmarks for 'sleep 0.3', 'sleep 0.5' and 'sleep 0.7'.
  -L, --parameter-list <VAR> <VALUES>
          Perform benchmark runs for each value in the comma-separated list
          VALUES. Replaces the string '{VAR}' in each command by the current
          parameter value.
          
          Example:  hyperfine -L compiler gcc,clang '{compiler} -O2 main.cpp'
          
          This performs benchmarks for 'gcc -O2 main.cpp' and 'clang -O2
          main.cpp'.
          
          The option can be specified multiple times to run benchmarks for all
          possible parameter combinations.
  -S, --shell <SHELL>
          Set the shell to use for executing benchmarked commands. This can be
          the name or the path to the shell executable, or a full command line
          like "bash --norc". It can also be set to "default" to explicitly
          select the default shell on this platform. Finally, this can also be
          set to "none" to disable the shell. In this case, commands will be
          executed directly. They can still have arguments, but more complex
          things like "sleep 0.1; sleep 0.2" are not possible without a shell.
  -N
          An alias for '--shell=none'.
  -i, --ignore-failure[=<MODE>]
          Ignore failures of the benchmarked programs. Without a value or with
          'all-non-zero', all non-zero exit codes are ignored. You can also
          provide a comma-separated list of exit codes to ignore (e.g.,
          --ignore-failure=1,2).
      --style <TYPE>
          Set output style type (default: auto). Set this to 'basic' to disable
          output coloring and interactive elements. Set it to 'full' to enable
          all effects even if no interactive terminal was detected. Set this to
          'nocolor' to keep the interactive output without any colors. Set this
          to 'color' to keep the colors without any interactive output. Set this
          to 'none' to disable all the output of the tool.
      --sort <METHOD>
          Specify the sort order of the speed comparison summary and the
          exported tables for markup formats (Markdown, AsciiDoc, org-mode):
            * 'auto' (default): the speed comparison will be ordered by time and
              the markup tables will be ordered by command (input order).
            * 'command': order benchmarks in the way they were specified
            * 'mean-time': order benchmarks by mean runtime
  -u, --time-unit <UNIT>
          Set the time unit to be used. Possible values: microsecond,
          millisecond, second. If the option is not given, the time unit is
          determined automatically. This option affects the standard output as
          well as all export formats except for CSV and JSON.
      --export-asciidoc <FILE>
          Export the timing summary statistics as an AsciiDoc table to the given
          FILE. The output time unit can be changed using the --time-unit
          option.
      --export-csv <FILE>
          Export the timing summary statistics as CSV to the given FILE. If you
          need the timing results for each individual run, use the JSON export
          format. The output time unit is always seconds.
      --export-json <FILE>
          Export the timing summary statistics and timings of individual runs as
          JSON to the given FILE. The output time unit is always seconds
      --export-markdown <FILE>
          Export the timing summary statistics as a Markdown table to the given
          FILE. The output time unit can be changed using the --time-unit
          option.
      --export-orgmode <FILE>
          Export the timing summary statistics as an Emacs org-mode table to the
          given FILE. The output time unit can be changed using the --time-unit
          option.
      --show-output
          Print the stdout and stderr of the benchmark instead of suppressing
          it. This will increase the time it takes for benchmarks to run, so it
          should only be used for debugging purposes or when trying to benchmark
          output speed.
      --output <WHERE>
          Control where the output of the benchmark is redirected. Note that
          some programs like 'grep' detect when standard output is /dev/null and
          apply certain optimizations. To avoid that, consider using
          '--output=pipe'.
          
          <WHERE> can be:
          
            null:     Redirect output to /dev/null (the default).
          
            pipe:     Feed the output through a pipe before discarding it.
          
            inherit:  Don't redirect the output at all (same as
            '--show-output').
          
            <FILE>:   Write the output to the given file.
          
          This option can be specified once for all commands or multiple times,
          once for each command. Note: If you want to log the output of each and
          every iteration, you can use a shell redirection and the
          '$HYPERFINE_ITERATION' environment variable:
              hyperfine 'my-command > output-${HYPERFINE_ITERATION}.log'
      --input <WHERE>
          Control where the input of the benchmark comes from.
          
          <WHERE> can be:
          
            null:     Read from /dev/null (the default).
          
            <FILE>:   Read the input from the given file.
  -n, --command-name <NAME>
          Give a meaningful name to a command. This can be specified multiple
          times if several commands are benchmarked.
  -h, --help
          Print help
  -V, --version
          Print version
"#;
    println!("{}", help);
}

fn main() {
    let args: Vec<String> = env::args().collect();
    for a in &args[1..] {
        if a=="-h" || a=="--help" {
            print_help();
            std::process::exit(0);
        }
        if a=="-V" || a=="--version" {
            println!("hyperfine 1.20.0");
            std::process::exit(0);
        }
    }

    let cmd = Command::new("hyperfine")
        .version("1.20.0")
        .about("A command-line benchmarking tool.")
        .disable_help_flag(true)
        .disable_version_flag(true)
        .override_usage("executable [OPTIONS] <command>...")
        .arg(Arg::new("warmup").short('w').long("warmup").value_name("NUM"))
        .arg(Arg::new("min-runs").short('m').long("min-runs").value_name("NUM"))
        .arg(Arg::new("max-runs").short('M').long("max-runs").value_name("NUM"))
        .arg(Arg::new("runs").short('r').long("runs").value_name("NUM"))
        .arg(Arg::new("setup").short('s').long("setup").value_name("CMD"))
        .arg(Arg::new("reference").long("reference").value_name("CMD"))
        .arg(Arg::new("reference-name").long("reference-name").value_name("CMD").requires("reference"))
        .arg(Arg::new("prepare").short('p').long("prepare").value_name("CMD").action(ArgAction::Append))
        .arg(Arg::new("conclude").short('C').long("conclude").value_name("CMD").action(ArgAction::Append))
        .arg(Arg::new("cleanup").short('c').long("cleanup").value_name("CMD"))
        .arg(Arg::new("parameter-scan").short('P').long("parameter-scan").value_names(["VAR","MIN","MAX"]).num_args(3))
        .arg(Arg::new("parameter-step-size").short('D').long("parameter-step-size").value_name("DELTA").requires("parameter-scan"))
        .arg(Arg::new("parameter-list").short('L').long("parameter-list").value_names(["VAR","VALUES"]).num_args(2).action(ArgAction::Append))
        .arg(Arg::new("shell").short('S').long("shell").value_name("SHELL"))
        .arg(Arg::new("shell_none").short('N').action(ArgAction::SetTrue).conflicts_with("shell"))
        .arg(Arg::new("ignore-failure").short('i').long("ignore-failure").value_name("MODE").num_args(0..=1).default_missing_value(""))
        .arg(Arg::new("style").long("style").value_name("TYPE").conflicts_with("show-output"))
        .arg(Arg::new("sort").long("sort").value_name("METHOD"))
        .arg(Arg::new("time-unit").short('u').long("time-unit").value_name("UNIT"))
        .arg(Arg::new("export-asciidoc").long("export-asciidoc").value_name("FILE"))
        .arg(Arg::new("export-csv").long("export-csv").value_name("FILE"))
        .arg(Arg::new("export-json").long("export-json").value_name("FILE"))
        .arg(Arg::new("export-markdown").long("export-markdown").value_name("FILE"))
        .arg(Arg::new("export-orgmode").long("export-orgmode").value_name("FILE"))
        .arg(Arg::new("show-output").long("show-output").action(ArgAction::SetTrue).conflicts_with("output"))
        .arg(Arg::new("output").long("output").value_name("WHERE").action(ArgAction::Append))
        .arg(Arg::new("input").long("input").value_name("WHERE"))
        .arg(Arg::new("command-name").short('n').long("command-name").value_name("NAME").action(ArgAction::Append))
        .arg(Arg::new("help").short('h').long("help").action(ArgAction::SetTrue))
        .arg(Arg::new("version").short('V').long("version").action(ArgAction::SetTrue))
        .arg(Arg::new("command").value_name("command").trailing_var_arg(true).allow_hyphen_values(true).num_args(0..));

    let matches = match cmd.try_get_matches() {
        Ok(m) => m,
        Err(e) => {
            e.print().unwrap();
            std::process::exit(e.exit_code());
        }
    };

    if matches.get_flag("help") {
        print_help();
        std::process::exit(0);
    }
    if matches.get_flag("version") {
        println!("hyperfine 1.20.0");
        std::process::exit(0);
    }

    let warmup: Option<u64> = matches.get_one::<String>("warmup").and_then(|s| s.parse().ok());
    let min_runs: Option<u64> = matches.get_one::<String>("min-runs").and_then(|s| s.parse().ok());
    let max_runs: Option<u64> = matches.get_one::<String>("max-runs").and_then(|s| s.parse().ok());
    let runs: Option<u64> = matches.get_one::<String>("runs").and_then(|s| s.parse().ok());
    let setup: Option<String> = matches.get_one::<String>("setup").cloned();
    let reference: Option<String> = matches.get_one::<String>("reference").cloned();
    let reference_name: Option<String> = matches.get_one::<String>("reference-name").cloned();
    let prepare: Vec<String> = matches.get_many::<String>("prepare").map(|v| v.cloned().collect()).unwrap_or_default();
    let conclude: Vec<String> = matches.get_many::<String>("conclude").map(|v| v.cloned().collect()).unwrap_or_default();
    let cleanup: Option<String> = matches.get_one::<String>("cleanup").cloned();
    let parameter_scan: Option<Vec<String>> = matches.get_many::<String>("parameter-scan").map(|v| v.cloned().collect());
    let parameter_step_size: Option<String> = matches.get_one::<String>("parameter-step-size").cloned();

    let mut param_list_manual: Vec<Vec<String>> = Vec::new();
    {
        let raw: Vec<String> = env::args().collect();
        let mut i=1;
        while i<raw.len() {
            let a = &raw[i];
            if a=="-L" || a=="--parameter-list" {
                if i+2 < raw.len() {
                    let var = raw[i+1].clone();
                    let vals = raw[i+2].clone();
                    param_list_manual.push(vec![var, vals]);
                    i+=3;
                    continue;
                }
            }
            i+=1;
        }
    }
    let parameter_list = param_list_manual;

    let shell: Option<String> = matches.get_one::<String>("shell").cloned();
    let shell_none = matches.get_flag("shell_none");
    let ignore_failure: Option<String> = matches.get_one::<String>("ignore-failure").cloned();
    let style: Option<String> = matches.get_one::<String>("style").cloned();
    let sort: Option<String> = matches.get_one::<String>("sort").cloned();
    let time_unit: Option<String> = matches.get_one::<String>("time-unit").cloned();
    let export_asciidoc: Option<String> = matches.get_one::<String>("export-asciidoc").cloned();
    let export_csv: Option<String> = matches.get_one::<String>("export-csv").cloned();
    let export_json: Option<String> = matches.get_one::<String>("export-json").cloned();
    let export_markdown: Option<String> = matches.get_one::<String>("export-markdown").cloned();
    let export_orgmode: Option<String> = matches.get_one::<String>("export-orgmode").cloned();
    let show_output = matches.get_flag("show-output");
    let output: Vec<String> = matches.get_many::<String>("output").map(|v| v.cloned().collect()).unwrap_or_default();
    let input: Option<String> = matches.get_one::<String>("input").cloned();
    let command_name: Vec<String> = matches.get_many::<String>("command-name").map(|v| v.cloned().collect()).unwrap_or_default();
    let commands: Vec<String> = matches.get_many::<String>("command").map(|v| v.cloned().collect()).unwrap_or_default();

    if let Some(ref tu) = time_unit {
        match tu.as_str() {
            "microsecond"|"millisecond"|"second" => {},
            _ => {
                eprintln!("error: invalid value '{}' for '--time-unit <UNIT>'\n  [possible values: microsecond, millisecond, second]\n\n  tip: a similar value exists: 'second'\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.", tu);
                std::process::exit(2);
            }
        }
    }
    if let Some(ref s) = sort {
        match s.as_str() {
            "auto"|"command"|"mean-time" => {},
            _ => {
                eprintln!("error: invalid value '{}' for '--sort <METHOD>'\n  [possible values: auto, command, mean-time]\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.", s);
                std::process::exit(2);
            }
        }
    }
    if let Some(ref st) = style {
        match st.as_str() {
            "auto"|"basic"|"full"|"nocolor"|"color"|"none" => {},
            _ => {
                eprintln!("error: invalid value '{}' for '--style <TYPE>'\n  [possible values: auto, basic, full, nocolor, color, none]\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.", st);
                std::process::exit(2);
            }
        }
    }

    if parameter_scan.is_some() && !parameter_list.is_empty() {
        eprintln!("error: the argument '--parameter-list <VAR> <VALUES>' cannot be used with '--parameter-scan <VAR> <MIN> <MAX>'\n\nUsage: executable --parameter-list <VAR> <VALUES> --runs <NUM> <command>...\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.");
        std::process::exit(2);
    }

    let mut param_names_set = HashSet::new();
    for pair in &parameter_list {
        let name = &pair[0];
        if param_names_set.contains(name) {
            eprintln!("Error: Duplicate parameter names: {}", name);
            std::process::exit(1);
        }
        param_names_set.insert(name.clone());
    }
    if let Some(v) = &parameter_scan {
        let var = &v[0];
        if param_names_set.contains(var) {
            eprintln!("Error: Duplicate parameter names: {}", var);
            std::process::exit(1);
        }
    }

    if let Some(v) = &parameter_scan {
        let min_s = &v[1];
        let max_s = &v[2];
        let min_is_float = min_s.contains('.') || min_s.contains('e') || min_s.contains('E');
        let max_is_float = max_s.contains('.') || max_s.contains('e') || max_s.contains('E');
        if (min_is_float || max_is_float) && parameter_step_size.is_none() {
            eprintln!("Error: A step size is required when the range bounds are floating point numbers. The step size can be specified with the '-D/--parameter-step-size <DELTA>' parameter");
            std::process::exit(1);
        }
    }

    let shell_opt_str: String = if shell_none { "none".to_string() } else if let Some(s) = shell.clone() { s } else { "default".to_string() };
    let base_commands = commands;
    if base_commands.is_empty() {
        eprintln!("error: the following required arguments were not provided:\n  <command>...\n\nUsage: executable [OPTIONS] <command>...\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.");
        std::process::exit(2);
    }

    #[derive(Clone)]
    struct ParamDef { var: String, values: Vec<String> }

    let mut param_defs: Vec<ParamDef> = Vec::new();

    if let Some(v) = &parameter_scan {
        let var = v[0].clone();
        let min_s = v[1].clone();
        let max_s = v[2].clone();
        let step_s = parameter_step_size.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| "1".to_string());
        let min_f: f64 = min_s.parse().unwrap_or_else(|_| { eprintln!("Error parsing min"); std::process::exit(1); });
        let max_f: f64 = max_s.parse().unwrap_or_else(|_| { eprintln!("Error parsing max"); std::process::exit(1); });
        let step_f: f64 = step_s.parse().unwrap_or_else(|_| { eprintln!("Error parsing step"); std::process::exit(1); });
        if step_f <= 0.0 { eprintln!("Error: step size must be positive"); std::process::exit(1); }
        fn decimal_places(s: &str) -> usize { if let Some(pos) = s.find('.') { s[pos+1..].len() } else { 0 } }
        fn significant_decimal_places(s: &str) -> usize { if let Some(pos) = s.find('.') { let frac = &s[pos+1..]; let trimmed = frac.trim_end_matches('0'); trimmed.len() } else { 0 } }
        let step_dec = decimal_places(&step_s);
        let min_sig = significant_decimal_places(&min_s);
        let mut values_str = Vec::new();
        let mut current = min_f;
        let mut idx = 0;
        loop {
            if current > max_f + 1e-9 { break; }
            if idx==0 {
                values_str.push(min_s.clone());
            } else {
                let prec = std::cmp::max(step_dec, min_sig);
                let fmt = if prec==0 { format!("{:.0}", current) } else { format!("{:.*}", prec, current) };
                values_str.push(fmt);
            }
            current += step_f;
            idx+=1;
            if idx>10000 { break; }
        }
        param_defs.push(ParamDef{ var, values: values_str });
    }

    for pair in &parameter_list {
        let var = pair[0].clone();
        let vals_str = pair[1].clone();
        let split: Vec<String> = vals_str.split(',').map(|s| s.trim().to_string()).filter(|s| !s.is_empty()).collect();
        if split.is_empty() { eprintln!("Error: parameter list empty for {}", var); std::process::exit(1); }
        param_defs.push(ParamDef{ var, values: split });
    }

    #[derive(Clone)]
    struct Combination { map: HashMap<String,String> }

    fn generate_combinations(defs: &[ParamDef]) -> Vec<Combination> {
        if defs.is_empty() { return vec![Combination{map: HashMap::new()}]; }
        let mut result = Vec::new();
        let first = &defs[0];
        let rest = &defs[1..];
        let rest_combos = generate_combinations(rest);
        for val in &first.values {
            for combo in &rest_combos {
                let mut map = combo.map.clone();
                map.insert(first.var.clone(), val.clone());
                result.push(Combination{map});
            }
        }
        result
    }

    let combinations = generate_combinations(&param_defs);

    struct ExpandedCommand {
        original: String,
        expanded: String,
        params: HashMap<String,String>,
        missing_vars: Vec<String>,
    }

    let mut expanded_commands: Vec<ExpandedCommand> = Vec::new();
    for base in &base_commands {
        for combo in &combinations {
            let mut exp = base.clone();
            let mut missing = Vec::new();
            for (var,val) in &combo.map {
                let placeholder = format!("{{{}}}", var);
                if exp.contains(&placeholder) {
                    exp = exp.replace(&placeholder, val);
                } else {
                    missing.push(var.clone());
                }
            }
            missing.sort();
            expanded_commands.push(ExpandedCommand{ original: base.clone(), expanded: exp, params: combo.map.clone(), missing_vars: missing });
        }
    }

    let has_reference = reference.is_some();
    let num_benchmarks_total = expanded_commands.len() + if has_reference {1} else {0};

    fn validate_count(name: &str, vec: &[String], n: usize) {
        if vec.is_empty() { return; }
        if vec.len()!=1 && vec.len()!=n {
            eprintln!("Error: The '{}' option has to be provided just once or N times, where N={} is the number of benchmark commands (including a potential reference).", name, n);
            std::process::exit(1);
        }
    }

    validate_count("--prepare", &prepare, num_benchmarks_total);
    validate_count("--conclude", &conclude, num_benchmarks_total);
    validate_count("--output", &output, num_benchmarks_total);

    if !command_name.is_empty() {
        if param_defs.is_empty() {
            let n = base_commands.len();
            if command_name.len() > n {
                eprintln!("Error: Too many --command-name options: Expected {} at most", n);
                std::process::exit(1);
            }
        } else {
            let n = expanded_commands.len();
            let c = command_name.len();
            if c!=0 && c!=1 && c!=n {
                eprintln!("Error: '--command-name' has been specified {} times. It has to appear exactly once, or exactly {} times (number of benchmarks)", c, n);
                std::process::exit(1);
            }
        }
    }

    for out in &output {
        if out=="null" || out=="pipe" || out=="inherit" { continue; }
        if out.contains('/') { continue; }
        else {
            eprintln!("Error: Unknown output policy '{}'. Use './{}' to output to a file named '{}'.", out, out, out);
            std::process::exit(1);
        }
    }

    if let Some(ref inp) = input {
        if inp!="null" {
            let p = Path::new(inp);
            if !p.exists() {
                eprintln!("Error: The file '{}' specified as '--input' does not exist", inp);
                std::process::exit(1);
            }
        }
    }

    let style_str = style.unwrap_or_else(|| "auto".to_string());
    let style = style_str.as_str();
    let sort_method = sort.unwrap_or_else(|| "auto".to_string());
    let time_unit_opt = time_unit.clone();
    let shell_default_path = "/bin/sh".to_string();
    let effective_shell: Option<Vec<String>> = if shell_opt_str=="none" {
        None
    } else if shell_opt_str=="default" {
        Some(vec![shell_default_path.clone()])
    } else {
        fn split_shell(s: &str) -> Vec<String> {
            let mut res = Vec::new();
            let mut cur = String::new();
            let mut in_single = false;
            let mut in_double = false;
            let mut escape = false;
            for c in s.chars() {
                if escape { cur.push(c); escape=false; continue; }
                if c=='\\' && !in_single { escape=true; continue; }
                if c=='\'' && !in_double { in_single=!in_single; continue; }
                if c=='"' && !in_single { in_double=!in_double; continue; }
                if c.is_whitespace() && !in_single && !in_double {
                    if !cur.is_empty() { res.push(cur.clone()); cur.clear(); }
                } else { cur.push(c); }
            }
            if !cur.is_empty() { res.push(cur); }
            res
        }
        let parts = split_shell(&shell_opt_str);
        if parts.is_empty() { Some(vec![shell_default_path.clone()]) } else { Some(parts) }
    };

    let mut shell_overhead = Duration::from_secs_f64(0.0);
    if let Some(ref shell_parts) = effective_shell {
        let shell_exe = &shell_parts[0];
        let shell_args = &shell_parts[1..];
        let mut times = Vec::new();
        for _ in 0..10 {
            let start = Instant::now();
            let mut cmd = ProcCommand::new(shell_exe);
            for a in shell_args { cmd.arg(a); }
            cmd.arg("-c"); cmd.arg("");
            cmd.stdout(Stdio::null()); cmd.stderr(Stdio::null()); cmd.stdin(Stdio::null());
            match cmd.status() {
                Ok(st) => {
                    if !st.success() {
                        eprintln!("Error: Could not measure shell execution time. Make sure you can run '{} -c \"\"'.", shell_opt_str);
                        std::process::exit(1);
                    }
                    times.push(start.elapsed());
                },
                Err(_) => {
                    eprintln!("Error: Could not measure shell execution time. Make sure you can run '{} -c \"\"'.", shell_opt_str);
                    std::process::exit(1);
                }
            }
        }
        let sum: Duration = times.iter().sum();
        shell_overhead = sum / (times.len() as u32);
    }

    #[derive(Clone)]
    enum IgnoreMode { All, Codes(HashSet<i32>) }
    let ignore_mode: Option<IgnoreMode> = if let Some(ref s) = ignore_failure {
        if s.is_empty() || s=="all-non-zero" {
            Some(IgnoreMode::All)
        } else {
            let mut set = HashSet::new();
            for part in s.split(',') {
                let p = part.trim();
                if p.is_empty() { continue; }
                if let Ok(code) = p.parse::<i32>() { set.insert(code); }
            }
            Some(IgnoreMode::Codes(set))
        }
    } else { None };

    fn execute_command(
        command_str: &str,
        shell_opt: &Option<Vec<String>>,
        iteration: usize,
        input_opt: &Option<String>,
        output_opt: &str,
        show_output: bool,
        shell_overhead: Duration,
    ) -> Result<(Duration, Duration, Duration, i32, u64), String> {
        fn split_cmd(s: &str) -> Vec<String> {
            let mut res = Vec::new();
            let mut cur = String::new();
            let mut in_single = false;
            let mut in_double = false;
            let mut escape = false;
            for c in s.chars() {
                if escape { cur.push(c); escape=false; continue; }
                if c=='\\' && !in_single { escape=true; continue; }
                if c=='\'' && !in_double { in_single=!in_single; continue; }
                if c=='"' && !in_single { in_double=!in_double; continue; }
                if c.is_whitespace() && !in_single && !in_double {
                    if !cur.is_empty() { res.push(cur.clone()); cur.clear(); }
                } else { cur.push(c); }
            }
            if !cur.is_empty() { res.push(cur); }
            res
        }

        let start = Instant::now();

        let mut proc = if let Some(shell_parts) = shell_opt {
            let shell_exe = &shell_parts[0];
            let shell_args = &shell_parts[1..];
            let mut cmd = ProcCommand::new(shell_exe);
            for a in shell_args { cmd.arg(a); }
            cmd.arg("-c"); cmd.arg(command_str);
            cmd.env("HYPERFINE_ITERATION", iteration.to_string());
            match input_opt {
                None => { cmd.stdin(Stdio::null()); },
                Some(s) if s=="null" => { cmd.stdin(Stdio::null()); },
                Some(file) => {
                    match File::open(file) {
                        Ok(f) => { cmd.stdin(Stdio::from(f)); },
                        Err(_) => { cmd.stdin(Stdio::null()); },
                    }
                }
            }
            if show_output {
                cmd.stdout(Stdio::inherit()); cmd.stderr(Stdio::inherit());
            } else {
                match output_opt {
                    "null" => { cmd.stdout(Stdio::null()); cmd.stderr(Stdio::null()); },
                    "pipe" => { cmd.stdout(Stdio::piped()); cmd.stderr(Stdio::piped()); },
                    "inherit" => { cmd.stdout(Stdio::inherit()); cmd.stderr(Stdio::inherit()); },
                    _ => {
                        let path = if output_opt.starts_with("./") { &output_opt[2..] } else { output_opt };
                        match OpenOptions::new().create(true).write(true).truncate(true).open(path) {
                            Ok(f) => {
                                let f2 = f.try_clone().unwrap();
                                cmd.stdout(Stdio::from(f));
                                cmd.stderr(Stdio::from(f2));
                            },
                            Err(_) => { cmd.stdout(Stdio::null()); cmd.stderr(Stdio::null()); }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            cmd.spawn().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?
        } else {
            let parts = split_cmd(command_str);
            if parts.is_empty() {
                let mut cmd = ProcCommand::new("true");
                cmd.env("HYPERFINE_ITERATION", iteration.to_string());
                match input_opt {
                    None => { cmd.stdin(Stdio::null()); },
                    Some(s) if s=="null" => { cmd.stdin(Stdio::null()); },
                    Some(file) => {
                        match File::open(file) {
                            Ok(f) => { cmd.stdin(Stdio::from(f)); },
                            Err(_) => { cmd.stdin(Stdio::null()); },
                        }
                    }
                }
                if show_output {
                    cmd.stdout(Stdio::inherit()); cmd.stderr(Stdio::inherit());
                } else {
                    match output_opt {
                        "null" => { cmd.stdout(Stdio::null()); cmd.stderr(Stdio::null()); },
                        "pipe" => { cmd.stdout(Stdio::piped()); cmd.stderr(Stdio::piped()); },
                        "inherit" => { cmd.stdout(Stdio::inherit()); cmd.stderr(Stdio::inherit()); },
                        _ => {
                            let path = if output_opt.starts_with("./") { &output_opt[2..] } else { output_opt };
                            match OpenOptions::new().create(true).write(true).truncate(true).open(path) {
                                Ok(f) => {
                                    let f2 = f.try_clone().unwrap();
                                    cmd.stdout(Stdio::from(f));
                                    cmd.stderr(Stdio::from(f2));
                                },
                                Err(_) => { cmd.stdout(Stdio::null()); cmd.stderr(Stdio::null()); }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                cmd.spawn().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?
            } else {
                let exe = parts[0].clone();
                let args = parts[1..].to_vec();
                let mut cmd = ProcCommand::new(&exe);
                cmd.args(&args);
                cmd.env("HYPERFINE_ITERATION", iteration.to_string());
                match input_opt {
                    None => { cmd.stdin(Stdio::null()); },
                    Some(s) if s=="null" => { cmd.stdin(Stdio::null()); },
                    Some(file) => {
                        match File::open(file) {
                            Ok(f) => { cmd.stdin(Stdio::from(f)); },
                            Err(_) => { cmd.stdin(Stdio::null()); },
                        }
                    }
                }
                if show_output {
                    cmd.stdout(Stdio::inherit()); cmd.stderr(Stdio::inherit());
                } else {
                    match output_opt {
                        "null" => { cmd.stdout(Stdio::null()); cmd.stderr(Stdio::null()); },
                        "pipe" => { cmd.stdout(Stdio::piped()); cmd.stderr(Stdio::piped()); },
                        "inherit" => { cmd.stdout(Stdio::inherit()); cmd.stderr(Stdio::inherit()); },
                        _ => {
                            let path = if output_opt.starts_with("./") { &output_opt[2..] } else { output_opt };
                            match OpenOptions::new().create(true).write(true).truncate(true).open(path) {
                                Ok(f) => {
                                    let f2 = f.try_clone().unwrap();
                                    cmd.stdout(Stdio::from(f));
                                    cmd.stderr(Stdio::from(f2));
                                },
                                Err(_) => { cmd.stdout(Stdio::null()); cmd.stderr(Stdio::null()); }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                match cmd.spawn() {
                    Ok(p) => p,
                    Err(_) => {
                        let elapsed = start.elapsed();
                        let adjusted = if elapsed > shell_overhead { elapsed - shell_overhead } else { Duration::from_secs_f64(0.0) };
                        return Ok((adjusted, Duration::from_secs_f64(0.0), Duration::from_secs_f64(0.0), 127, 0));
                    }
                }
            }
        };

        let pid = proc.id() as i32;
        let mut status: i32 = 0;
        let mut rusage = unsafe { std::mem::zeroed::<libc::rusage>() };
        let res = unsafe { libc::wait4(pid, &mut status as *mut i32, 0, &mut rusage as *mut libc::rusage) };
        let real_elapsed = start.elapsed();

        if res < 0 {
            let _ = proc.wait();
            let adjusted = if real_elapsed > shell_overhead { real_elapsed - shell_overhead } else { Duration::from_secs_f64(0.0) };
            return Ok((adjusted, Duration::from_secs_f64(0.0), Duration::from_secs_f64(0.0), 127, 0));
        }

        let exit_code = if libc::WIFEXITED(status) { libc::WEXITSTATUS(status) } else if libc::WIFSIGNALED(status) { 128 + libc::WTERMSIG(status) } else { 127 };
        let user = Duration::new(rusage.ru_utime.tv_sec as u64, (rusage.ru_utime.tv_usec as u32)*1000);
        let system = Duration::new(rusage.ru_stime.tv_sec as u64, (rusage.ru_stime.tv_usec as u32)*1000);
        let mem_bytes = (rusage.ru_maxrss as u64) * 1024;

        let adjusted_real = if shell_opt.is_some() {
            if real_elapsed > shell_overhead { real_elapsed - shell_overhead } else { Duration::from_secs_f64(0.0) }
        } else { real_elapsed };

        Ok((adjusted_real, user, system, exit_code, mem_bytes))
    }

    fn run_aux_command(cmd_str: &str, shell_opt: &Option<Vec<String>>, iteration: Option<usize>, show_output: bool) -> std::process::ExitStatus {
        let shell_to_use = if let Some(sp) = shell_opt { sp.clone() } else { vec!["/bin/sh".to_string()] };
        let shell_exe = &shell_to_use[0];
        let shell_args = &shell_to_use[1..];
        let mut proc = ProcCommand::new(shell_exe);
        for a in shell_args { proc.arg(a); }
        proc.arg("-c"); proc.arg(cmd_str);
        if let Some(it) = iteration { proc.env("HYPERFINE_ITERATION", it.to_string()); }
        if show_output {
            proc.stdout(Stdio::inherit()); proc.stderr(Stdio::inherit()); proc.stdin(Stdio::null());
        } else {
            proc.stdout(Stdio::null()); proc.stderr(Stdio::null()); proc.stdin(Stdio::null());
        }
        proc.status().unwrap_or_else(|_| ProcCommand::new("false").status().unwrap())
    }

    #[derive(Clone)]
    struct BenchSpec {
        run_cmd: String,
        display_name: String,
        json_command: String,
        params: Option<HashMap<String,String>>,
        original_idx: usize,
        is_reference: bool,
    }

    let mut bench_specs: Vec<BenchSpec> = Vec::new();

    if let Some(ref_cmd) = reference.clone() {
        let display = if let Some(rn) = reference_name.clone() { rn } else { ref_cmd.clone() };
        bench_specs.push(BenchSpec{ run_cmd: ref_cmd.clone(), display_name: display.clone(), json_command: display.clone(), params: None, original_idx: 0, is_reference: true });
    }

    fn build_suffix(missing: &[String], params: &HashMap<String,String>) -> String {
        if missing.is_empty() { return "".to_string(); }
        let mut parts = Vec::new();
        for var in missing {
            if let Some(val) = params.get(var) { parts.push(format!("{} = {}", var, val)); }
        }
        if parts.is_empty() { "".to_string() } else { format!(" ({})", parts.join(", ")) }
    }

    for (idx, exp_cmd) in expanded_commands.iter().enumerate() {
        let display_name = if !command_name.is_empty() {
            if param_defs.is_empty() {
                if idx < command_name.len() {
                    command_name[idx].clone()
                } else {
                    if command_name.len()==1 && idx!=0 {
                        let suffix = build_suffix(&exp_cmd.missing_vars, &exp_cmd.params);
                        if suffix.is_empty() { exp_cmd.expanded.clone() } else { format!("{}{}", exp_cmd.original, suffix) }
                    } else if idx < command_name.len() {
                        command_name[idx].clone()
                    } else {
                        let suffix = build_suffix(&exp_cmd.missing_vars, &exp_cmd.params);
                        if suffix.is_empty() { exp_cmd.expanded.clone() } else { format!("{}{}", exp_cmd.original, suffix) }
                    }
                }
            } else {
                if command_name.len()==1 {
                    let base = command_name[0].clone();
                    let suffix = build_suffix(&exp_cmd.missing_vars, &exp_cmd.params);
                    format!("{}{}", base, suffix)
                } else if command_name.len()==expanded_commands.len() {
                    command_name[idx].clone()
                } else {
                    let base = command_name[0].clone();
                    let suffix = build_suffix(&exp_cmd.missing_vars, &exp_cmd.params);
                    format!("{}{}", base, suffix)
                }
            }
        } else {
            let suffix = build_suffix(&exp_cmd.missing_vars, &exp_cmd.params);
            if suffix.is_empty() {
                exp_cmd.expanded.clone()
            } else {
                if exp_cmd.missing_vars.is_empty() { exp_cmd.expanded.clone() } else { format!("{}{}", exp_cmd.original, suffix) }
            }
        };

        let json_command = if !command_name.is_empty() {
            if param_defs.is_empty() {
                if idx < command_name.len() { command_name[idx].clone() }
                else if command_name.len()==1 && idx==0 { command_name[0].clone() }
                else { exp_cmd.expanded.clone() }
            } else {
                if command_name.len()==1 { command_name[0].clone() } else if idx < command_name.len() { command_name[idx].clone() } else { exp_cmd.expanded.clone() }
            }
        } else {
            if exp_cmd.missing_vars.is_empty() { exp_cmd.expanded.clone() } else { exp_cmd.original.clone() }
        };

        bench_specs.push(BenchSpec{
            run_cmd: exp_cmd.expanded.clone(),
            display_name,
            json_command,
            params: if exp_cmd.params.is_empty() { None } else { Some(exp_cmd.params.clone()) },
            original_idx: idx + if has_reference {1} else {0},
            is_reference: false,
        });
    }

    struct RunData { times: Vec<f64>, user_times: Vec<f64>, system_times: Vec<f64>, memories: Vec<u64>, exit_codes: Vec<i32> }

    fn get_mapped_value(vec: &[String], idx: usize) -> Option<String> {
        if vec.is_empty() { return None; }
        if vec.len()==1 { return Some(vec[0].clone()); }
        if idx < vec.len() { return Some(vec[idx].clone()); }
        None
    }

    fn compute_stats(times: &[f64], user_times: &[f64], system_times: &[f64]) -> (f64, Option<f64>, f64, f64, f64, f64, f64) {
        let n = times.len() as f64;
        let sum: f64 = times.iter().sum();
        let mean = sum / n;
        let stddev = if times.len()<=1 { None } else { let var: f64 = times.iter().map(|&x| (x-mean)*(x-mean)).sum::<f64>() / (n-1.0); Some(var.sqrt()) };
        let mut sorted = times.to_vec(); sorted.sort_by(|a,b| a.partial_cmp(b).unwrap());
        let median = if sorted.len()%2==1 { sorted[sorted.len()/2] } else { (sorted[sorted.len()/2 -1] + sorted[sorted.len()/2])/2.0 };
        let user_sum: f64 = user_times.iter().sum(); let user_mean = user_sum / n;
        let sys_sum: f64 = system_times.iter().sum(); let sys_mean = sys_sum / n;
        let min = sorted[0]; let max = sorted[sorted.len()-1];
        (mean, stddev, median, user_mean, sys_mean, min, max)
    }

    let default_min_runs = 10u64;

    let mut all_run_data: Vec<(BenchSpec, RunData)> = Vec::new();

    for (bench_idx, bench) in bench_specs.iter().enumerate() {
        let prepare_cmd = get_mapped_value(&prepare, bench_idx);
        let conclude_cmd = get_mapped_value(&conclude, bench_idx);
        let output_policy = get_mapped_value(&output, bench_idx).unwrap_or_else(|| "null".to_string());

        if let Some(ref setup_cmd) = setup {
            let shell_for_aux = effective_shell.clone();
            let status = run_aux_command(setup_cmd, &shell_for_aux, None, show_output);
            if !status.success() {
                eprintln!("Error: The setup command terminated with a non-zero exit code. Append ' || true' to the command if you are sure that this can be ignored.");
                std::process::exit(1);
            }
        }

        for w in 0..warmup.unwrap_or(0) {
            if let Some(ref prep) = prepare_cmd {
                let shell_for_aux = effective_shell.clone();
                let status = run_aux_command(prep, &shell_for_aux, Some(w as usize), show_output);
                if !status.success() {
                    eprintln!("Error: The preparation command terminated with a non-zero exit code. Append ' || true' to the command if you are sure that this can be ignored.");
                    std::process::exit(1);
                }
            }
            let _ = execute_command(&bench.run_cmd, &effective_shell, w as usize, &input, &output_policy, show_output, shell_overhead);
            if let Some(ref concl) = conclude_cmd {
                let shell_for_aux = effective_shell.clone();
                let _ = run_aux_command(concl, &shell_for_aux, Some(w as usize), show_output);
            }
        }

        let num_runs: u64 = if let Some(r) = runs { r } else {
            if let Some(ref prep) = prepare_cmd {
                let shell_for_aux = effective_shell.clone();
                let status = run_aux_command(prep, &shell_for_aux, Some(0), show_output);
                if !status.success() {
                    eprintln!("Error: The preparation command terminated with a non-zero exit code. Append ' || true' to the command if you are sure that this can be ignored.");
                    std::process::exit(1);
                }
            }
            let (t, _u, _s, code, _mem) = match execute_command(&bench.run_cmd, &effective_shell, 0, &input, &output_policy, show_output, shell_overhead) {
                Ok(v) => v,
                Err(_) => (Duration::from_secs_f64(0.1), Duration::from_secs_f64(0.0), Duration::from_secs_f64(0.0), 0, 0),
            };
            if let Some(ref concl) = conclude_cmd {
                let shell_for_aux = effective_shell.clone();
                let _ = run_aux_command(concl, &shell_for_aux, Some(0), show_output);
            }
            let should_ignore = match &ignore_mode {
                Some(IgnoreMode::All) => true,
                Some(IgnoreMode::Codes(set)) => set.contains(&code),
                None => false,
            };
            if code!=0 && !should_ignore {
                eprintln!("Error: Command terminated with non-zero exit code {} in the first benchmark run. Use the '-i'/'--ignore-failure' option if you want to ignore this. Alternatively, use the '--show-output' option to debug what went wrong.", code);
                std::process::exit(1);
            }
            let est_secs = t.as_secs_f64();
            let target_total = 3.0;
            let mut needed = if est_secs > 0.0 { (target_total / est_secs).ceil() as u64 } else { default_min_runs };
            let min_r = min_runs.unwrap_or(default_min_runs);
            if needed < min_r { needed = min_r; }
            if let Some(max_r) = max_runs { if needed > max_r { needed = max_r; } }
            if needed < 1 { needed = 1; }
            needed
        };

        let mut run_data = RunData{ times: Vec::new(), user_times: Vec::new(), system_times: Vec::new(), memories: Vec::new(), exit_codes: Vec::new() };

        for iter in 0..num_runs {
            if let Some(ref prep) = prepare_cmd {
                let shell_for_aux = effective_shell.clone();
                let status = run_aux_command(prep, &shell_for_aux, Some(iter as usize), show_output);
                if !status.success() {
                    eprintln!("Error: The preparation command terminated with a non-zero exit code. Append ' || true' to the command if you are sure that this can be ignored.");
                    std::process::exit(1);
                }
            }

            let (real_dur, user_dur, sys_dur, exit_code, mem) = match execute_command(&bench.run_cmd, &effective_shell, iter as usize, &input, &output_policy, show_output, shell_overhead) {
                Ok(v) => v,
                Err(e) => { eprintln!("Error executing: {}", e); std::process::exit(1); }
            };

            let should_ignore = match &ignore_mode {
                Some(IgnoreMode::All) => true,
                Some(IgnoreMode::Codes(set)) => set.contains(&exit_code),
                None => false,
            };
            if exit_code!=0 && !should_ignore {
                eprintln!("Error: Command terminated with non-zero exit code {} in the first benchmark run. Use the '-i'/'--ignore-failure' option if you want to ignore this. Alternatively, use the '--show-output' option to debug what went wrong.", exit_code);
                std::process::exit(1);
            }

            run_data.times.push(real_dur.as_secs_f64());
            run_data.user_times.push(user_dur.as_secs_f64());
            run_data.system_times.push(sys_dur.as_secs_f64());
            run_data.memories.push(mem);
            run_data.exit_codes.push(exit_code);

            if let Some(ref concl) = conclude_cmd {
                let shell_for_aux = effective_shell.clone();
                let _ = run_aux_command(concl, &shell_for_aux, Some(iter as usize), show_output);
            }
        }

        if let Some(ref cleanup_cmd) = cleanup {
            let shell_for_aux = effective_shell.clone();
            let _ = run_aux_command(cleanup_cmd, &shell_for_aux, None, show_output);
        }

        all_run_data.push((BenchSpec{
            run_cmd: bench.run_cmd.clone(),
            display_name: bench.display_name.clone(),
            json_command: bench.json_command.clone(),
            params: bench.params.clone(),
            original_idx: bench.original_idx,
            is_reference: bench.is_reference,
        }, run_data));
    }

    fn choose_time_unit_auto(results: &[(BenchSpec, RunData)]) -> String {
        let mut min_mean = std::f64::MAX;
        for (_, rd) in results {
            let mean = rd.times.iter().sum::<f64>() / (rd.times.len() as f64);
            if mean < min_mean { min_mean = mean; }
        }
        if min_mean < 0.001 { "microsecond".to_string() } else if min_mean < 1.0 { "millisecond".to_string() } else { "second".to_string() }
    }

    let display_time_unit = if let Some(ref tu) = time_unit_opt { tu.clone() } else { choose_time_unit_auto(&all_run_data) };

    fn fmt_time(secs: f64, unit: &str) -> String {
        match unit {
            "microsecond" => format!("{:.1} µs", secs*1_000_000.0),
            "millisecond" => format!("{:.1} ms", secs*1000.0),
            "second" => format!("{:.3} s", secs),
            _ => format!("{:.3} s", secs),
        }
    }

    let style_is_none = style=="none";

    // For zero detection, check if any mean is 0
    let has_zero = all_run_data.iter().any(|(_, rd)| {
        let mean = rd.times.iter().sum::<f64>() / (rd.times.len() as f64);
        mean == 0.0
    });

    if !style_is_none {
        for (idx, (bench, rd)) in all_run_data.iter().enumerate() {
            println!("Benchmark {}: {}", idx+1, bench.display_name);
            let (mean, stddev, _median, user_mean, sys_mean, min, max) = compute_stats(&rd.times, &rd.user_times, &rd.system_times);
            if rd.times.len()==1 {
                let time_str = fmt_time(mean, &display_time_unit);
                let user_str = fmt_time(user_mean, &display_time_unit);
                let sys_str = fmt_time(sys_mean, &display_time_unit);
                let width = if display_time_unit=="microsecond" { 18 } else { 16 };
                println!("  Time (abs ≡):{:>width$}               [User: {}, System: {}]", time_str, user_str, sys_str, width=width);
                println!("");
                if mean < 0.005 {
                    println!("  Warning: Command took less than 5 ms to complete. Note that the results might be inaccurate because hyperfine can not calibrate the shell startup time much more precise than this limit. You can try to use the `-N`/`--shell=none` option to disable the shell completely.");
                    println!("");
                }
            } else {
                let mean_str = fmt_time(mean, &display_time_unit);
                let std_str = if let Some(s) = stddev { fmt_time(s, &display_time_unit) } else { fmt_time(0.0, &display_time_unit) };
                let user_str = fmt_time(user_mean, &display_time_unit);
                let sys_str = fmt_time(sys_mean, &display_time_unit);
                let min_str = fmt_time(min, &display_time_unit);
                let max_str = fmt_time(max, &display_time_unit);
                let mean_width = if display_time_unit=="microsecond" { 15 } else { 13 };
                let std_width = 8;
                println!("  Time (mean ± σ):{:>mean_w$} ± {:>std_w$}    [User: {}, System: {}]", mean_str, std_str, user_str, sys_str, mean_w=mean_width, std_w=std_width);
                println!("  Range (min … max):{:>mean_w$} … {:>std_w$}    {} runs", min_str, max_str, rd.times.len(), mean_w=mean_width, std_w=std_width);
                println!("");
                if mean < 0.005 {
                    println!("  Warning: Command took less than 5 ms to complete. Note that the results might be inaccurate because hyperfine can not calibrate the shell startup time much more precise than this limit. You can try to use the `-N`/`--shell=none` option to disable the shell completely.");

        .arg(Arg::new("export-csv").long("export-csv").value_name("FILE"))
        .arg(Arg::new("export-json").long("export-json").value_name("FILE"))

    let min_runs: Option<u64> = matches.get_one::<String>("min-runs").and_then(|s| s.parse().ok());

    #[derive(Clone)]

        let min_s = v[1].clone();
        let max_s = v[2].clone();

        let max_f: f64 = max_s.parse().unwrap_or_else(|_| { eprintln!("Error parsing max"); std::process::exit(1); });

        if step_f <= 0.0 { eprintln!("Error: step size must be positive"); std::process::exit(1); }
        fn decimal_places(s: &str) -> usize { if let Some(pos) = s.find('.') { s[pos+1..].len() } else { 0 } }
        fn significant_decimal_places(s: &str) -> usize { if let Some(pos) = s.find('.') { let frac = &s[pos+1..]; let trimmed = frac.trim_end_matches('0'); trimmed.len() } else { 0 } }
        let step_dec = decimal_places(&step_s);
        let min_sig = significant_decimal_places(&min_s);
        let mut values_str = Vec::new();
        let mut current = min_f;
        let mut idx = 0;
        loop {
            if current > max_f + 1e-9 { break; }
            if idx==0 {

            } else {
                let prec = std::cmp::max(step_dec, min_sig);
                let fmt = if prec==0 { format!("{:.0}", current) } else { format!("{:.*}", prec, current) };
                values_str.push(fmt);
            }
            current += step_f;
            idx+=1;
            if idx>10000 { break; }
        }
        param_defs.push(ParamDef{ var, values: values_str });
    }

    for pair in &parameter_list {

    fn generate_combinations(defs: &[ParamDef]) -> Vec<Combination> {

        let mut result = Vec::new();
        let first = &defs[0];
        let rest = &defs[1..];
        let rest_combos = generate_combinations(rest);
        for val in &first.values {
            for combo in &rest_combos {
                let mut map = combo.map.clone();
                map.insert(first.var.clone(), val.clone());
                result.push(Combination{map});
            }
        }
        result
    }

    let combinations = generate_combinations(&param_defs);

    struct ExpandedCommand {

        expanded: String,
        params: HashMap<String,String>,
        missing_vars: Vec<String>,

    for base in &base_commands {
        for combo in &combinations {
            let mut exp = base.clone();
            let mut missing = Vec::new();
            for (var,val) in &combo.map {
                let placeholder = format!("{{{}}}", var);
                if exp.contains(&placeholder) {
                    exp = exp.replace(&placeholder, val);
                } else {
                    missing.push(var.clone());
                }
            }
            missing.sort();
            expanded_commands.push(ExpandedCommand{ original: base.clone(), expanded: exp, params: combo.map.clone(), missing_vars: missing });
