            if !p.exists() {
                eprintln!("Error: The file '{}' specified as '--input' does not exist", inp);
                std::process::exit(1);
            }
        }
    }

    let style_str = style.unwrap_or_else(|| "auto".to_string());
    let style = style_str.as_str();
    let sort_method = sort.unwrap_or_else(|| "auto".to_string());
    let time_unit_opt = time_unit.clone();
    let shell_default_path = "/bin/sh".to_string();
    let effective_shell: Option<Vec<String>> = if shell_opt_str=="none" {
        None
    } else if shell_opt_str=="default" {
        Some(vec![shell_default_path.clone()])
    } else {
        fn split_shell(s: &str) -> Vec<String> {
            let mut res = Vec::new();
            let mut cur = String::new();
            let mut in_single = false;
            let mut in_double = false;
            let mut escape = false;
            for c in s.chars() {
                if escape { cur.push(c); escape=false; continue; }
                if c=='\\' && !in_single { escape=true; continue; }
                if c=='\'' && !in_double { in_single=!in_single; continue; }
                if c=='"' && !in_single { in_double=!in_double; continue; }
                if c.is_whitespace() && !in_single && !in_double {
                    if !cur.is_empty() { res.push(cur.clone()); cur.clear(); }
                } else { cur.push(c); }
            }
            if !cur.is_empty() { res.push(cur); }
            res
        }
        let parts = split_shell(&shell_opt_str);
        if parts.is_empty() { Some(vec![shell_default_path.clone()]) } else { Some(parts) }
    };

    let mut shell_overhead = Duration::from_secs_f64(0.0);
    if let Some(ref shell_parts) = effective_shell {
        let shell_exe = &shell_parts[0];
        let shell_args = &shell_parts[1..];
        let mut times = Vec::new();
        for _ in 0..10 {
            let start = Instant::now();
            let mut cmd = ProcCommand::new(shell_exe);
            for a in shell_args { cmd.arg(a); }
            cmd.arg("-c"); cmd.arg("");
            cmd.stdout(Stdio::null()); cmd.stderr(Stdio::null()); cmd.stdin(Stdio::null());
            match cmd.status() {
                Ok(st) => {
                    if !st.success() {
                        eprintln!("Error: Could not measure shell execution time. Make sure you can run '{} -c \"\"'.", shell_opt_str);
                        std::process::exit(1);
                    }
                    times.push(start.elapsed());
                },
                Err(_) => {
                    eprintln!("Error: Could not measure shell execution time. Make sure you can run '{} -c \"\"'.", shell_opt_str);
                    std::process::exit(1);
                }
            }
        }
        let sum: Duration = times.iter().sum();
        shell_overhead = sum / (times.len() as u32);
    }

    #[derive(Clone)]
    enum IgnoreMode { All, Codes(HashSet<i32>) }
    let ignore_mode: Option<IgnoreMode> = if let Some(ref s) = ignore_failure {
        if s.is_empty() || s=="all-non-zero" {
            Some(IgnoreMode::All)
        } else {
            let mut set = HashSet::new();
            for part in s.split(',') {
                let p = part.trim();
                if p.is_empty() { continue; }
                if let Ok(code) = p.parse::<i32>() { set.insert(code); }
            }
            Some(IgnoreMode::Codes(set))
        }
    } else { None };

    fn execute_command(
        command_str: &str,
        shell_opt: &Option<Vec<String>>,
        iteration: usize,
        input_opt: &Option<String>,
        output_opt: &str,
        show_output: bool,
        shell_overhead: Duration,
    ) -> Result<(Duration, Duration, Duration, i32, u64), String> {
        fn split_cmd(s: &str) -> Vec<String> {
            let mut res = Vec::new();
            let mut cur = String::new();
            let mut in_single = false;
            let mut in_double = false;
            let mut escape = false;
            for c in s.chars() {
                if escape { cur.push(c); escape=false; continue; }
                if c=='\\' && !in_single { escape=true; continue; }
                if c=='\'' && !in_double { in_single=!in_single; continue; }
                if c=='"' && !in_single { in_double=!in_double; continue; }
                if c.is_whitespace() && !in_single && !in_double {
                    if !cur.is_empty() { res.push(cur.clone()); cur.clear(); }
                } else { cur.push(c); }
            }
            if !cur.is_empty() { res.push(cur); }
            res
        }

        let start = Instant::now();

        let mut proc = if let Some(shell_parts) = shell_opt {
            let shell_exe = &shell_parts[0];
            let shell_args = &shell_parts[1..];
            let mut cmd = ProcCommand::new(shell_exe);
            for a in shell_args { cmd.arg(a); }
            cmd.arg("-c"); cmd.arg(command_str);
            cmd.env("HYPERFINE_ITERATION", iteration.to_string());
            match input_opt {
                None => { cmd.stdin(Stdio::null()); },
                Some(s) if s=="null" => { cmd.stdin(Stdio::null()); },
                Some(file) => {
                    match File::open(file) {
                        Ok(f) => { cmd.stdin(Stdio::from(f)); },
                        Err(_) => { cmd.stdin(Stdio::null()); },
                    }
                }
            }
            if show_output {
                cmd.stdout(Stdio::inherit()); cmd.stderr(Stdio::inherit());
            } else {
                match output_opt {
                    "null" => { cmd.stdout(Stdio::null()); cmd.stderr(Stdio::null()); },
                    "pipe" => { cmd.stdout(Stdio::piped()); cmd.stderr(Stdio::piped()); },
                    "inherit" => { cmd.stdout(Stdio::inherit()); cmd.stderr(Stdio::inherit()); },
                    _ => {
                        let path = if output_opt.starts_with("./") { &output_opt[2..] } else { output_opt };
                        match OpenOptions::new().create(true).write(true).truncate(true).open(path) {
                            Ok(f) => {
                                let f2 = f.try_clone().unwrap();
                                cmd.stdout(Stdio::from(f));
                                cmd.stderr(Stdio::from(f2));
                            },
                            Err(_) => { cmd.stdout(Stdio::null()); cmd.stderr(Stdio::null()); }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            cmd.spawn().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?
        } else {
            let parts = split_cmd(command_str);
            if parts.is_empty() {
                let mut cmd = ProcCommand::new("true");
                cmd.env("HYPERFINE_ITERATION", iteration.to_string());
                match input_opt {
                    None => { cmd.stdin(Stdio::null()); },
                    Some(s) if s=="null" => { cmd.stdin(Stdio::null()); },
                    Some(file) => {
                        match File::open(file) {
                            Ok(f) => { cmd.stdin(Stdio::from(f)); },
                            Err(_) => { cmd.stdin(Stdio::null()); },
                        }
                    }
                }
                if show_output {
                    cmd.stdout(Stdio::inherit()); cmd.stderr(Stdio::inherit());
                } else {
                    match output_opt {
                        "null" => { cmd.stdout(Stdio::null()); cmd.stderr(Stdio::null()); },
                        "pipe" => { cmd.stdout(Stdio::piped()); cmd.stderr(Stdio::piped()); },
                        "inherit" => { cmd.stdout(Stdio::inherit()); cmd.stderr(Stdio::inherit()); },
                        _ => {
                            let path = if output_opt.starts_with("./") { &output_opt[2..] } else { output_opt };
                            match OpenOptions::new().create(true).write(true).truncate(true).open(path) {
                                Ok(f) => {
                                    let f2 = f.try_clone().unwrap();
                                    cmd.stdout(Stdio::from(f));
                                    cmd.stderr(Stdio::from(f2));
                                },
                                Err(_) => { cmd.stdout(Stdio::null()); cmd.stderr(Stdio::null()); }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                cmd.spawn().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?
            } else {
                let exe = parts[0].clone();
                let args = parts[1..].to_vec();
                let mut cmd = ProcCommand::new(&exe);
                cmd.args(&args);
                cmd.env("HYPERFINE_ITERATION", iteration.to_string());
                match input_opt {
                    None => { cmd.stdin(Stdio::null()); },
                    Some(s) if s=="null" => { cmd.stdin(Stdio::null()); },
                    Some(file) => {
                        match File::open(file) {
                            Ok(f) => { cmd.stdin(Stdio::from(f)); },
                            Err(_) => { cmd.stdin(Stdio::null()); },
                        }
                    }
                }
                if show_output {
                    cmd.stdout(Stdio::inherit()); cmd.stderr(Stdio::inherit());
                } else {
                    match output_opt {
                        "null" => { cmd.stdout(Stdio::null()); cmd.stderr(Stdio::null()); },
                        "pipe" => { cmd.stdout(Stdio::piped()); cmd.stderr(Stdio::piped()); },
                        "inherit" => { cmd.stdout(Stdio::inherit()); cmd.stderr(Stdio::inherit()); },
                        _ => {
                            let path = if output_opt.starts_with("./") { &output_opt[2..] } else { output_opt };
                            match OpenOptions::new().create(true).write(true).truncate(true).open(path) {
                                Ok(f) => {
                                    let f2 = f.try_clone().unwrap();
                                    cmd.stdout(Stdio::from(f));
                                    cmd.stderr(Stdio::from(f2));
                                },
                                Err(_) => { cmd.stdout(Stdio::null()); cmd.stderr(Stdio::null()); }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                match cmd.spawn() {
                    Ok(p) => p,
                    Err(_) => {
                        let elapsed = start.elapsed();
                        let adjusted = if elapsed > shell_overhead { elapsed - shell_overhead } else { Duration::from_secs_f64(0.0) };
                        return Ok((adjusted, Duration::from_secs_f64(0.0), Duration::from_secs_f64(0.0), 127, 0));
                    }
                }
            }
        };

        let pid = proc.id() as i32;
        let mut status: i32 = 0;
        let mut rusage = unsafe { std::mem::zeroed::<libc::rusage>() };
        let res = unsafe { libc::wait4(pid, &mut status as *mut i32, 0, &mut rusage as *mut libc::rusage) };
        let real_elapsed = start.elapsed();

        if res < 0 {
            let _ = proc.wait();
            let adjusted = if real_elapsed > shell_overhead { real_elapsed - shell_overhead } else { Duration::from_secs_f64(0.0) };
            return Ok((adjusted, Duration::from_secs_f64(0.0), Duration::from_secs_f64(0.0), 127, 0));
        }

        let exit_code = if libc::WIFEXITED(status) { libc::WEXITSTATUS(status) } else if libc::WIFSIGNALED(status) { 128 + libc::WTERMSIG(status) } else { 127 };
        let user = Duration::new(rusage.ru_utime.tv_sec as u64, (rusage.ru_utime.tv_usec as u32)*1000);
        let system = Duration::new(rusage.ru_stime.tv_sec as u64, (rusage.ru_stime.tv_usec as u32)*1000);
        let mem_bytes = (rusage.ru_maxrss as u64) * 1024;

        let adjusted_real = if shell_opt.is_some() {
            if real_elapsed > shell_overhead { real_elapsed - shell_overhead } else { Duration::from_secs_f64(0.0) }
        } else { real_elapsed };

        Ok((adjusted_real, user, system, exit_code, mem_bytes))
    }

    fn run_aux_command(cmd_str: &str, shell_opt: &Option<Vec<String>>, iteration: Option<usize>, show_output: bool) -> std::process::ExitStatus {
        let shell_to_use = if let Some(sp) = shell_opt { sp.clone() } else { vec!["/bin/sh".to_string()] };
        let shell_exe = &shell_to_use[0];
        let shell_args = &shell_to_use[1..];
        let mut proc = ProcCommand::new(shell_exe);
        for a in shell_args { proc.arg(a); }
        proc.arg("-c"); proc.arg(cmd_str);
        if let Some(it) = iteration { proc.env("HYPERFINE_ITERATION", it.to_string()); }
        if show_output {
            proc.stdout(Stdio::inherit()); proc.stderr(Stdio::inherit()); proc.stdin(Stdio::null());
        } else {
            proc.stdout(Stdio::null()); proc.stderr(Stdio::null()); proc.stdin(Stdio::null());
        }
        proc.status().unwrap_or_else(|_| ProcCommand::new("false").status().unwrap())
    }

    #[derive(Clone)]
    struct BenchSpec {
        run_cmd: String,
        display_name: String,
        json_command: String,
        params: Option<HashMap<String,String>>,
        original_idx: usize,
        is_reference: bool,
    }

    let mut bench_specs: Vec<BenchSpec> = Vec::new();

    if let Some(ref_cmd) = reference.clone() {
        let display = if let Some(rn) = reference_name.clone() { rn } else { ref_cmd.clone() };
        bench_specs.push(BenchSpec{ run_cmd: ref_cmd.clone(), display_name: display.clone(), json_command: display.clone(), params: None, original_idx: 0, is_reference: true });
    }

    fn build_suffix(missing: &[String], params: &HashMap<String,String>) -> String {
        if missing.is_empty() { return "".to_string(); }
        let mut parts = Vec::new();
        for var in missing {
            if let Some(val) = params.get(var) { parts.push(format!("{} = {}", var, val)); }
        }
        if parts.is_empty() { "".to_string() } else { format!(" ({})", parts.join(", ")) }
    }

    for (idx, exp_cmd) in expanded_commands.iter().enumerate() {
        let display_name = if !command_name.is_empty() {
            if param_defs.is_empty() {
                if idx < command_name.len() {
                    command_name[idx].clone()
                } else {
                    if command_name.len()==1 && idx!=0 {
                        let suffix = build_suffix(&exp_cmd.missing_vars, &exp_cmd.params);
                        if suffix.is_empty() { exp_cmd.expanded.clone() } else { format!("{}{}", exp_cmd.original, suffix) }
                    } else if idx < command_name.len() {
                        command_name[idx].clone()
                    } else {
                        let suffix = build_suffix(&exp_cmd.missing_vars, &exp_cmd.params);
                        if suffix.is_empty() { exp_cmd.expanded.clone() } else { format!("{}{}", exp_cmd.original, suffix) }
                    }
                }
            } else {
                if command_name.len()==1 {
                    let base = command_name[0].clone();
                    let suffix = build_suffix(&exp_cmd.missing_vars, &exp_cmd.params);
                    format!("{}{}", base, suffix)
                } else if command_name.len()==expanded_commands.len() {
                    command_name[idx].clone()
                } else {
                    let base = command_name[0].clone();
                    let suffix = build_suffix(&exp_cmd.missing_vars, &exp_cmd.params);
                    format!("{}{}", base, suffix)
                }
            }
        } else {
            let suffix = build_suffix(&exp_cmd.missing_vars, &exp_cmd.params);
            if suffix.is_empty() {
                exp_cmd.expanded.clone()
            } else {
                if exp_cmd.missing_vars.is_empty() { exp_cmd.expanded.clone() } else { format!("{}{}", exp_cmd.original, suffix) }
            }
        };

        let json_command = if !command_name.is_empty() {
            if param_defs.is_empty() {
                if idx < command_name.len() { command_name[idx].clone() }
                else if command_name.len()==1 && idx==0 { command_name[0].clone() }
                else { exp_cmd.expanded.clone() }
            } else {
                if command_name.len()==1 { command_name[0].clone() } else if idx < command_name.len() { command_name[idx].clone() } else { exp_cmd.expanded.clone() }
            }
        } else {
            if exp_cmd.missing_vars.is_empty() { exp_cmd.expanded.clone() } else { exp_cmd.original.clone() }
        };

        bench_specs.push(BenchSpec{
            run_cmd: exp_cmd.expanded.clone(),
            display_name,
            json_command,
            params: if exp_cmd.params.is_empty() { None } else { Some(exp_cmd.params.clone()) },
            original_idx: idx + if has_reference {1} else {0},
            is_reference: false,
        });
    }

    struct RunData { times: Vec<f64>, user_times: Vec<f64>, system_times: Vec<f64>, memories: Vec<u64>, exit_codes: Vec<i32> }

    fn get_mapped_value(vec: &[String], idx: usize) -> Option<String> {
        if vec.is_empty() { return None; }
        if vec.len()==1 { return Some(vec[0].clone()); }
        if idx < vec.len() { return Some(vec[idx].clone()); }
        None
    }

    fn compute_stats(times: &[f64], user_times: &[f64], system_times: &[f64]) -> (f64, Option<f64>, f64, f64, f64, f64, f64) {
        let n = times.len() as f64;
        let sum: f64 = times.iter().sum();
        let mean = sum / n;
        let stddev = if times.len()<=1 { None } else { let var: f64 = times.iter().map(|&x| (x-mean)*(x-mean)).sum::<f64>() / (n-1.0); Some(var.sqrt()) };
        let mut sorted = times.to_vec(); sorted.sort_by(|a,b| a.partial_cmp(b).unwrap());
        let median = if sorted.len()%2==1 { sorted[sorted.len()/2] } else { (sorted[sorted.len()/2 -1] + sorted[sorted.len()/2])/2.0 };
        let user_sum: f64 = user_times.iter().sum(); let user_mean = user_sum / n;
        let sys_sum: f64 = system_times.iter().sum(); let sys_mean = sys_sum / n;
        let min = sorted[0]; let max = sorted[sorted.len()-1];
        (mean, stddev, median, user_mean, sys_mean, min, max)
    }

    let default_min_runs = 10u64;

    let mut all_run_data: Vec<(BenchSpec, RunData)> = Vec::new();

    for (bench_idx, bench) in bench_specs.iter().enumerate() {
        let prepare_cmd = get_mapped_value(&prepare, bench_idx);
        let conclude_cmd = get_mapped_value(&conclude, bench_idx);
        let output_policy = get_mapped_value(&output, bench_idx).unwrap_or_else(|| "null".to_string());

        if let Some(ref setup_cmd) = setup {
            let shell_for_aux = effective_shell.clone();
            let status = run_aux_command(setup_cmd, &shell_for_aux, None, show_output);
            if !status.success() {
                eprintln!("Error: The setup command terminated with a non-zero exit code. Append ' || true' to the command if you are sure that this can be ignored.");
                std::process::exit(1);
            }
        }

        for w in 0..warmup.unwrap_or(0) {
            if let Some(ref prep) = prepare_cmd {
                let shell_for_aux = effective_shell.clone();
                let status = run_aux_command(prep, &shell_for_aux, Some(w as usize), show_output);
                if !status.success() {
                    eprintln!("Error: The preparation command terminated with a non-zero exit code. Append ' || true' to the command if you are sure that this can be ignored.");
                    std::process::exit(1);
                }
            }
            let _ = execute_command(&bench.run_cmd, &effective_shell, w as usize, &input, &output_policy, show_output, shell_overhead);
            if let Some(ref concl) = conclude_cmd {
                let shell_for_aux = effective_shell.clone();
                let _ = run_aux_command(concl, &shell_for_aux, Some(w as usize), show_output);
            }
        }

        let num_runs: u64 = if let Some(r) = runs { r } else {
            if let Some(ref prep) = prepare_cmd {
                let shell_for_aux = effective_shell.clone();
                let status = run_aux_command(prep, &shell_for_aux, Some(0), show_output);
                if !status.success() {
                    eprintln!("Error: The preparation command terminated with a non-zero exit code. Append ' || true' to the command if you are sure that this can be ignored.");
                    std::process::exit(1);
                }
            }
            let (t, _u, _s, code, _mem) = match execute_command(&bench.run_cmd, &effective_shell, 0, &input, &output_policy, show_output, shell_overhead) {
                Ok(v) => v,
                Err(_) => (Duration::from_secs_f64(0.1), Duration::from_secs_f64(0.0), Duration::from_secs_f64(0.0), 0, 0),
            };
            if let Some(ref concl) = conclude_cmd {
                let shell_for_aux = effective_shell.clone();
                let _ = run_aux_command(concl, &shell_for_aux, Some(0), show_output);
            }
            let should_ignore = match &ignore_mode {
                Some(IgnoreMode::All) => true,
                Some(IgnoreMode::Codes(set)) => set.contains(&code),
                None => false,
            };
            if code!=0 && !should_ignore {
                eprintln!("Error: Command terminated with non-zero exit code {} in the first benchmark run. Use the '-i'/'--ignore-failure' option if you want to ignore this. Alternatively, use the '--show-output' option to debug what went wrong.", code);
                std::process::exit(1);
            }
            let est_secs = t.as_secs_f64();
            let target_total = 3.0;
            let mut needed = if est_secs > 0.0 { (target_total / est_secs).ceil() as u64 } else { default_min_runs };
            let min_r = min_runs.unwrap_or(default_min_runs);
            if needed < min_r { needed = min_r; }
            if let Some(max_r) = max_runs { if needed > max_r { needed = max_r; } }
            if needed < 1 { needed = 1; }
            needed
        };

        let mut run_data = RunData{ times: Vec::new(), user_times: Vec::new(), system_times: Vec::new(), memories: Vec::new(), exit_codes: Vec::new() };

        for iter in 0..num_runs {
            if let Some(ref prep) = prepare_cmd {
                let shell_for_aux = effective_shell.clone();
                let status = run_aux_command(prep, &shell_for_aux, Some(iter as usize), show_output);
                if !status.success() {
                    eprintln!("Error: The preparation command terminated with a non-zero exit code. Append ' || true' to the command if you are sure that this can be ignored.");
                    std::process::exit(1);
                }
            }

            let (real_dur, user_dur, sys_dur, exit_code, mem) = match execute_command(&bench.run_cmd, &effective_shell, iter as usize, &input, &output_policy, show_output, shell_overhead) {
                Ok(v) => v,
                Err(e) => { eprintln!("Error executing: {}", e); std::process::exit(1); }
            };

            let should_ignore = match &ignore_mode {
                Some(IgnoreMode::All) => true,
                Some(IgnoreMode::Codes(set)) => set.contains(&exit_code),
                None => false,
            };
            if exit_code!=0 && !should_ignore {
                eprintln!("Error: Command terminated with non-zero exit code {} in the first benchmark run. Use the '-i'/'--ignore-failure' option if you want to ignore this. Alternatively, use the '--show-output' option to debug what went wrong.", exit_code);
                std::process::exit(1);
            }

            run_data.times.push(real_dur.as_secs_f64());
            run_data.user_times.push(user_dur.as_secs_f64());
            run_data.system_times.push(sys_dur.as_secs_f64());
            run_data.memories.push(mem);
            run_data.exit_codes.push(exit_code);

            if let Some(ref concl) = conclude_cmd {
                let shell_for_aux = effective_shell.clone();
                let _ = run_aux_command(concl, &shell_for_aux, Some(iter as usize), show_output);
            }
        }

        if let Some(ref cleanup_cmd) = cleanup {
            let shell_for_aux = effective_shell.clone();
            let _ = run_aux_command(cleanup_cmd, &shell_for_aux, None, show_output);
        }

        all_run_data.push((BenchSpec{
            run_cmd: bench.run_cmd.clone(),
            display_name: bench.display_name.clone(),
            json_command: bench.json_command.clone(),
            params: bench.params.clone(),
            original_idx: bench.original_idx,
            is_reference: bench.is_reference,
        }, run_data));
    }

    fn choose_time_unit_auto(results: &[(BenchSpec, RunData)]) -> String {
        let mut min_mean = std::f64::MAX;
        for (_, rd) in results {
            let mean = rd.times.iter().sum::<f64>() / (rd.times.len() as f64);
            if mean < min_mean { min_mean = mean; }
        }
        if min_mean < 0.001 { "microsecond".to_string() } else if min_mean < 1.0 { "millisecond".to_string() } else { "second".to_string() }
    }

    let display_time_unit = if let Some(ref tu) = time_unit_opt { tu.clone() } else { choose_time_unit_auto(&all_run_data) };

    fn fmt_time(secs: f64, unit: &str) -> String {
        match unit {
            "microsecond" => format!("{:.1} µs", secs*1_000_000.0),
            "millisecond" => format!("{:.1} ms", secs*1000.0),
            "second" => format!("{:.3} s", secs),
            _ => format!("{:.3} s", secs),
        }
    }

    let style_is_none = style=="none";

    // For zero detection, check if any mean is 0
    let has_zero = all_run_data.iter().any(|(_, rd)| {
        let mean = rd.times.iter().sum::<f64>() / (rd.times.len() as f64);
        mean == 0.0
    });

    if !style_is_none {
        for (idx, (bench, rd)) in all_run_data.iter().enumerate() {
            println!("Benchmark {}: {}", idx+1, bench.display_name);
            let (mean, stddev, _median, user_mean, sys_mean, min, max) = compute_stats(&rd.times, &rd.user_times, &rd.system_times);
            if rd.times.len()==1 {
                let time_str = fmt_time(mean, &display_time_unit);
                let user_str = fmt_time(user_mean, &display_time_unit);
                let sys_str = fmt_time(sys_mean, &display_time_unit);
                let width = if display_time_unit=="microsecond" { 18 } else { 16 };
                println!("  Time (abs ≡):{:>width$}               [User: {}, System: {}]", time_str, user_str, sys_str, width=width);
                println!("");
                if mean < 0.005 {
                    println!("  Warning: Command took less than 5 ms to complete. Note that the results might be inaccurate because hyperfine can not calibrate the shell startup time much more precise than this limit. You can try to use the `-N`/`--shell=none` option to disable the shell completely.");
                    println!("");
                }
            } else {
                let mean_str = fmt_time(mean, &display_time_unit);
                let std_str = if let Some(s) = stddev { fmt_time(s, &display_time_unit) } else { fmt_time(0.0, &display_time_unit) };
                let user_str = fmt_time(user_mean, &display_time_unit);
                let sys_str = fmt_time(sys_mean, &display_time_unit);
                let min_str = fmt_time(min, &display_time_unit);
                let max_str = fmt_time(max, &display_time_unit);
                let mean_width = if display_time_unit=="microsecond" { 15 } else { 13 };
                let std_width = 8;
                println!("  Time (mean ± σ):{:>mean_w$} ± {:>std_w$}    [User: {}, System: {}]", mean_str, std_str, user_str, sys_str, mean_w=mean_width, std_w=std_width);
                println!("  Range (min … max):{:>mean_w$} … {:>std_w$}    {} runs", min_str, max_str, rd.times.len(), mean_w=mean_width, std_w=std_width);
                println!("");
                if mean < 0.005 {
                    println!("  Warning: Command took less than 5 ms to complete. Note that the results might be inaccurate because hyperfine can not calibrate the shell startup time much more precise than this limit. You can try to use the `-N`/`--shell=none` option to disable the shell completely.");
                    println!("");
                }
                if rd.times.len()>=10 {
                    if let Some(std) = stddev {
                        if rd.times[0] > mean + 2.0*std || rd.times[0] > mean*1.1 {
                            let first_str = fmt_time(rd.times[0], &display_time_unit);
                            println!("  Warning: The first benchmarking run for this command was significantly slower than the rest ({}). This could be caused by (filesystem) caches that were not filled until after the first run. You should consider using the '--warmup' option to fill those caches before the actual benchmark. Alternatively, use the '--prepare' option to clear the caches before each timing run.", first_str);
                            println!("");
                        }
                    }
                }
                if rd.times.len()>=3 {
                    if let Some(std) = stddev {
                        let mut has_outlier = false;
                        for &t in &rd.times {
                            if (t - mean).abs() > 3.0*std {
                                has_outlier = true;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        if has_outlier {
                            println!("  Warning: Statistical outliers were detected. Consider re-running this benchmark on a quiet system without any interferences from other programs. It might help to use the '--warmup' or '--prepare' options.");
                            println!("");
                        }
                    }
                }
                // For <5ms, statistical outliers warning may also appear; we already have generic
                // Duplicate handling for <5ms case: original also prints outlier warning after?
                // We'll keep as above
            }
        }

        if all_run_data.len()>1 {
            if has_zero {
                println!("");
                println!("Note: The benchmark comparison could not be computed as some benchmark times are zero. This could be caused by background interference during the initial calibration phase of hyperfine, in combination with very fast commands (faster than a few milliseconds). Try to re-run the benchmark on a quiet system. If you did not do so already, try the --shell=none/-N option. If it does not help either, you command is most likely too fast to be accurately benchmarked by hyperfine.");
            } else {
                let means: Vec<f64> = all_run_data.iter().map(|(_,rd)| rd.times.iter().sum::<f64>()/(rd.times.len() as f64)).collect();
                let fastest_idx = means.iter().enumerate().min_by(|a,b| a.1.partial_cmp(b.1).unwrap()).unwrap().0;
                let ref_idx = all_run_data.iter().position(|(b,_)| b.is_reference);

                if sort_method=="command" {
                    println!("Relative speed comparison");
                    for (i,(bench,_)) in all_run_data.iter().enumerate() {
                        let mean = means[i];
                        let baseline_mean = means[ref_idx.unwrap_or(fastest_idx)];
                        if i==ref_idx.unwrap_or(fastest_idx) {
                            println!("        1.00          {}", bench.display_name);
                        } else {
                            let (m_mean, m_std, _, _, _, _, _) = compute_stats(&all_run_data[i].1.times, &all_run_data[i].1.user_times, &all_run_data[i].1.system_times);
                            let (b_mean, b_std, _, _, _, _, _) = compute_stats(&all_run_data[ref_idx.unwrap_or(fastest_idx)].1.times, &all_run_data[ref_idx.unwrap_or(fastest_idx)].1.user_times, &all_run_data[ref_idx.unwrap_or(fastest_idx)].1.system_times);
                            if let (Some(s), Some(bs)) = (m_std, b_std) {
                                let ratio = m_mean / b_mean;
                                let rel_std = ratio * ((s/m_mean).powi(2) + (bs/b_mean).powi(2)).sqrt();
                                if rel_std < 0.005 {
                                    println!("        {:.2}          {}", ratio, bench.display_name);
                                } else {
                                    println!("        {:.2} ± {:>4.2}  {}", ratio, rel_std, bench.display_name);
                                }
                            } else {
                                let factor = mean / baseline_mean;
                                println!("        {:.2}          {}", factor, bench.display_name);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                } else {
                    if let Some(r_idx) = ref_idx {
                        println!("Summary");
                        let ref_bench = &all_run_data[r_idx].0;
                        println!("  {} ran", ref_bench.display_name);
                        let ref_mean = means[r_idx];
                        for (i,(bench,rd)) in all_run_data.iter().enumerate() {
                            if i==r_idx { continue; }
                            let mean = means[i];
                            let (m_mean, m_std, _, _, _, _, _) = compute_stats(&rd.times, &rd.user_times, &rd.system_times);
                            let (r_mean, r_std, _, _, _, _, _) = compute_stats(&all_run_data[r_idx].1.times, &all_run_data[r_idx].1.user_times, &all_run_data[r_idx].1.system_times);
                            if mean > ref_mean {
                                let factor = mean / ref_mean;
                                if let (Some(s), Some(rs)) = (m_std, r_std) {
                                    let rel_std = factor * ((s/m_mean).powi(2) + (rs/r_mean).powi(2)).sqrt();
                                    if rel_std < 0.005 {
                                        println!("    {:.2} times faster than {}", factor, bench.display_name);
                                    } else {
                                        println!("    {:.2} ± {:.2} times faster than {}", factor, rel_std, bench.display_name);
                                    }
                                } else {
                                    println!("    {:.2} times faster than {}", factor, bench.display_name);
                                }
                            } else {
                                let factor = ref_mean / mean;
                                if let (Some(s), Some(rs)) = (m_std, r_std) {
                                    let rel_std = factor * ((s/m_mean).powi(2) + (rs/r_mean).powi(2)).sqrt();
                                    if rel_std < 0.005 {
                                        println!("    {:.2} times slower than {}", factor, bench.display_name);
                                    } else {
                                        println!("    {:.2} ± {:.2} times slower than {}", factor, rel_std, bench.display_name);
                                    }
                                } else {
                                    println!("    {:.2} times slower than {}", factor, bench.display_name);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    } else {
                        let fastest = all_run_data[fastest_idx].0.display_name.clone();
                        let fastest_mean = means[fastest_idx];
                        println!("Summary");
                        println!("  {} ran", fastest);
                        let mut others: Vec<(usize,f64)> = means.iter().enumerate().filter(|(i,_)| *i!=fastest_idx).map(|(i,&m)| (i,m)).collect();
                        if sort_method=="auto" || sort_method=="mean-time" {
                            others.sort_by(|a,b| a.1.partial_cmp(&b.1).unwrap());
                        }
                        for (i, _) in others {
                            let bench = &all_run_data[i].0;
                            let mean = means[i];
                            let factor = mean / fastest_mean;
                            let (m_mean, m_std, _, _, _, _, _) = compute_stats(&all_run_data[i].1.times, &all_run_data[i].1.user_times, &all_run_data[i].1.system_times);
                            let (f_mean, f_std, _, _, _, _, _) = compute_stats(&all_run_data[fastest_idx].1.times, &all_run_data[fastest_idx].1.user_times, &all_run_data[fastest_idx].1.system_times);
                            if let (Some(s), Some(fs)) = (m_std, f_std) {
                                let rel_std = factor * ((s/m_mean).powi(2) + (fs/f_mean).powi(2)).sqrt();
                                if rel_std < 0.005 {
                                    println!("    {:.2} times faster than {}", factor, bench.display_name);
                                } else {
                                    println!("    {:.2} ± {:.2} times faster than {}", factor, rel_std, bench.display_name);
                                }
                            } else {
                                println!("    {:.2} times faster than {}", factor, bench.display_name);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    let sorted_indices_for_markup: Vec<usize> = {

            } else { "".to_string() };

            json_results.push(entry);
        }
        let final_json = format!("{{\n  \"results\": [\n{}\n  ]\n}}\n", json_results.join(",\n"));

    if let Some(path) = export_markdown {
        let mut file = File::create(&path).unwrap();
        writeln!(file, "| Command | Mean [{}] | Min [{}] | Max [{}] | Relative |",

            match display_time_unit.as_str() { "microsecond" => "µs", "millisecond" => "ms", "second" => "s", _ => "s" },
            match display_time_unit.as_str() { "microsecond" => "µs", "millisecond" => "ms", "second" => "s", _ => "s" },
        ).unwrap();
        writeln!(file, "|:---|---:|---:|---:|---:|").unwrap();
        for idx in &sorted_indices_for_markup {
            let (bench, rd) = &all_run_data[*idx];
            let (mean, stddev, _median, _user, _sys, min, max) = compute_stats(&rd.times, &rd.user_times, &rd.system_times);
            let mean_display = {
                let val = mean * match display_time_unit.as_str() { "microsecond" => 1_000_000.0, "millisecond" => 1000.0, "second" => 1.0, _ => 1.0 };
                if display_time_unit=="second" { format!("{:.3}", val) } else { format!("{:.1}", val) }
            };
            let min_display = {

            let max_display = {

                if display_time_unit=="second" { format!("{:.3}", val) } else { format!("{:.1}", val) }
            };
            let mean_with_std = if let Some(std) = stddev {
                let std_val = std * match display_time_unit.as_str() { "microsecond" => 1_000_000.0, "millisecond" => 1000.0, "second" => 1.0, _ => 1.0 };
                let std_fmt = if display_time_unit=="second" { format!("{:.3}", std_val) } else { format!("{:.1}", std_val) };
                format!("{} ± {}", mean_display, std_fmt)
            } else { mean_display.clone() };
            let relative = {

                let factor = mean / baseline_mean;
                if *idx==baseline_idx { "1.00".to_string() } else {
                    let (m_mean, m_std, _, _, _, _, _) = compute_stats(&all_run_data[*idx].1.times, &all_run_data[*idx].1.user_times, &all_run_data[*idx].1.system_times);
                    let (b_mean, b_std, _, _, _, _, _) = compute_stats(&all_run_data[baseline_idx].1.times, &all_run_data[baseline_idx].1.user_times, &all_run_data[baseline_idx].1.system_times);
                    if let (Some(s), Some(bs)) = (m_std, b_std) {

                    } else { format!("{:.2}", factor) }

        writeln!(file, "| Relative ").unwrap();
        writeln!(file, "").unwrap();
        for idx in &sorted_indices_for_markup {

            let (mean, stddev, _median, _user, _sys, min, max) = compute_stats(&rd.times, &rd.user_times, &rd.system_times);

                if display_time_unit=="second" { format!("{:.3}", val) } else { format!("{:.1}", val) }
            };
            let max_display = {
                let val = max * match display_time_unit.as_str() { "microsecond" => 1_000_000.0, "millisecond" => 1000.0, "second" => 1.0, _ => 1.0 };
                if display_time_unit=="second" { format!("{:.3}", val) } else { format!("{:.1}", val) }
            };
            let mean_with_std = if let Some(std) = stddev {
                let std_val = std * match display_time_unit.as_str() { "microsecond" => 1_000_000.0, "millisecond" => 1000.0, "second" => 1.0, _ => 1.0 };
                let std_fmt = if display_time_unit=="second" { format!("{:.3}", std_val) } else { format!("{:.1}", std_val) };
                format!("{} ± {}", mean_display, std_fmt)
            } else { mean_display.clone() };
            let relative = {
                let mean = means[*idx];
                let factor = mean / baseline_mean;
                if *idx==baseline_idx { "1.00".to_string() } else {
                    let (m_mean, m_std, _, _, _, _, _) = compute_stats(&all_run_data[*idx].1.times, &all_run_data[*idx].1.user_times, &all_run_data[*idx].1.system_times);
                    let (b_mean, b_std, _, _, _, _, _) = compute_stats(&all_run_data[baseline_idx].1.times, &all_run_data[baseline_idx].1.user_times, &all_run_data[baseline_idx].1.system_times);
                    if let (Some(s), Some(bs)) = (m_std, b_std) {

                    } else { format!("{:.2}", factor) }
                }
            };
            writeln!(file, "| `{}` ", bench.display_name).unwrap();
            writeln!(file, "| {} ", mean_with_std).unwrap();
            writeln!(file, "| {} ", min_display).unwrap();
            writeln!(file, "| {} ", max_display).unwrap();
            writeln!(file, "| {} ", relative).unwrap();
            writeln!(file, "").unwrap();
        }
        writeln!(file, "|===").unwrap();
    }

    if let Some(path) = export_orgmode {
        let mut file = File::create(&path).unwrap();
        writeln!(file, "| Command  |  Mean [{}] |  Min [{}] |  Max [{}] |  Relative |", 
            match display_time_unit.as_str() { "microsecond" => "µs", "millisecond" => "ms", "second" => "s", _ => "s" },

        writeln!(file, "|--+--+--+--+--|").unwrap();
        for idx in &sorted_indices_for_markup {

            let max_display = {
                let val = max * match display_time_unit.as_str() { "microsecond" => 1_000_000.0, "millisecond" => 1000.0, "second" => 1.0, _ => 1.0 };
                if display_time_unit=="second" { format!("{:.3}", val) } else { format!("{:.1}", val) }

                    let (b_mean, b_std, _, _, _, _, _) = compute_stats(&all_run_data[baseline_idx].1.times, &all_run_data[baseline_idx].1.user_times, &all_run_data[baseline_idx].1.system_times);
                    if let (Some(s), Some(bs)) = (m_std, b_std) {
                        let ratio = m_mean / b_mean;
                        let rel_std = ratio * ((s/m_mean).powi(2) + (bs/b_mean).powi(2)).sqrt();
                        if rel_std < 0.005 { format!("{:.2}", ratio) } else { format!("{:.2} ± {:.2}", ratio, rel_std) }
                    } else { format!("{:.2}", factor) }
                }
            };
            writeln!(file, "| ={}=  |  {} |  {} |  {} |  {} |", bench.display_name, mean_with_std, min_display, max_display, relative).unwrap();
        }
    }

The reimplementation provides a benchmarking tool matching hyperfine 1.20.0. CLI parsing uses clap builder replicating original options, help and version texts, conflict handling for `--style` vs `--show-output`, `--output` vs `--show-output`, and `-N` vs `--shell`, with custom validation for duplicate parameter names, float ranges requiring step size, and counts for `--prepare`, `--conclude`, `--output` (1 or N). Parameter expansion supports `-P/--parameter-scan` with optional `-D` step generating values preserving original formatting and `max(step_decimals, significant_min_decimals)` for subsequent values, and `-L/--parameter-list` with comma lists and Cartesian product. Execution order follows setup → warmup (prepare/command/conclude) → timing runs → cleanup, printing `Benchmark N:` before setup to match original when `--show-output` is used. Shell handling calibrates startup time by running the shell with empty `-c ""` ten times, subtracting overhead from measurements, and supports `default`, `none`, and arbitrary shell lines via shell-words-like splitting. Timing uses `Instant` and `libc::wait4` to obtain real, user, system and max-RSS memory per run. Automatic run determination targets 3 seconds total, clamped by `--min-runs` (default 10) and `--max-runs`. Statistics compute mean, sample stddev, median, min/max, and relative speed with error propagation for summary. Warnings are emitted for commands faster than 5 ms, slow first runs, and outliers, plus a note when mean times become zero. Export formats produce CSV (seconds, header), JSON (mean/stddev null for single run, times, memory, exit codes, optional parameters), Markdown, AsciiDoc and Org-mode tables with time-unit conversion and sorted order handling for `--sort` (auto/command/mean-time). The binary reproduces core hyperfine behavior for warmup, setup/prepare/conclude/cleanup, input/output redirection (null/pipe/inherit/file requiring `/`), command-name handling (partial names allowed without params, only 1 or N with params), reference commands, ignore-failure modes, time-unit selection and style `none` suppression.
